title: Continuation state vector
description: The compact, authoritative record of where a run stands (protocol/state_vector.md). Stored in run_state.json under 'state_vector' and rewritten at the end of every session (checkpoint.py update-vector). A fresh session continues from it.

session.description: Sitting number; incremented once per sitting (0 before the first).

phase.description: Stage of the run: one of init, life_plan, map, scope, search, followups, merge, verify, deliverables, done. A transition is written 'A → B' in the session it happens.

session_objective.description: What this sitting set out to do.

context.description: Session-determined decisions that shape later work and are not recorded elsewhere (never restates the Preamble).

unknowns.description: Missing data, unverified facts, measurement gaps. Each must be routed to active/next or to assumptions.

ambiguities.description: Inputs from the person that need clarifying. Blocking: resolved first in the next session.

assumptions.description: Positions taken despite unknowns, each with its basis.

basis.description: Why it was made, so a later answer can overturn it cleanly.

completed.description: Results, decisions and milestones (facts, not effort).

active.description: Work in progress, split by owner (substantive actions only).

user.description: In progress on the person's side.

next.description: The next concrete actions, split by owner. next.virgil[0] is the first thing the next session does.

artifacts.description: Files and links produced, as paths relative to the run directory.
